name: Pozole
subtitle: From missionaries in Mexico, via Kelsey

items: 1½ pounds pork, cut into ½ inch pieces

steps.title: Combine the base
steps.body: In a big pot, combine **4 cups water**, **1½ pounds pork**, cut into ½ inch pieces, **½ cup onion**, chopped, **1 clove garlic** and **¼ tsp cumin**.

steps.title: Simmer the pork
steps.body: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for one hour.

steps.title: Add the hominy and seasonings
steps.body: Add **1 × 29 ounce can hominy**, **1 Tbsp chili powder**, **1½ tsp salt** and **¼ tsp pepper**.

steps.title: Simmer until tender
steps.body: Continue to simmer 45–60 minutes, until the meat is tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve hot, topped with any/all of the following: cabbage, cilantro, green onions, shredded cheese, avocado, tomato, jalapeno and sliced radish.
